import json,os,signal,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from multi_robot_exploration import spawn_entity_checked as spawn
base=Path('log/p3b5_native_clock_dev');base.mkdir(exist_ok=True,parents=True)
xml=Path('install/multi_robot/share/multi_robot/models/turtlebot3_waffle/model.sdf')
log=(base/'gazebo.log').open('w')
process=subprocess.Popen(['gzserver','--verbose','install/multi_robot/share/multi_robot/worlds/my_world.world','-s','libgazebo_ros_init.so','-s','libgazebo_ros_factory.so'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
# Intentionally remove the optional ModelStates path. Inventory must work
# through the native read service, with one physical insertion only.
spawn.Node.create_subscription=lambda *a,**k: None
start=time.monotonic();results=[]
try:
 for attempt in range(5):
  results.append(spawn.main(['probe','-file',str(xml),'-entity',f'clock_tb{min(attempt,3)}','-robot_namespace',f'/clock_tb{min(attempt,3)}','-y',str(min(attempt,3)*1.5),'-timeout','30']))
 result={'created_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'model_states_subscription_disabled':True,'spawn_returncodes':results,'wall_time_sec':time.monotonic()-start,'pass':results==[0,0,0,0,1]}
 (base/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result))
 assert result['pass']
finally:
 os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGINT)
 try:process.wait(timeout=10)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL);process.wait()
 log.close()
